content.text:
**Finding submitted — deviation (MINCOMMIT), fallback cure.**

- **Responsive locations reviewed:** § 5(a) (p0045, minimum monthly fees for Hosting and Support Services), § 6 (p0047, minimum fees carved out of Client's documentation/dispute rights), § 13 (p0078, one-year term auto-renewing for successive one-year periods), § 14 (p0079, Client's termination-on-notice right, expressly "Subject to Section 4"), § 4 (p0043, open-ended "not less than ____ months" Support Services period), plus § 2/§ 3 and § 8 — no volume caps on Client usage found there.
- **Why it fails fallback:** the fee floor is unconditional and usage-independent, is not confined to the current 12-month term (it rides through automatic renewals), there is no reduction right, and there is no true-up mechanic; the only exit is subordinated to a blank-length Support Services period.
- **Cure:** one short inserted proviso (§ 5(b)) carrying exactly the three fallback elements — current 12-month term only, reducible on 30 days' written notice, shortfall trued up rather than penalised. We left the fee floor and the Section 6 carve-outs untouched to avoid collateral rewrites that deleting to our preferred position would require.
